channel.title: The Assam Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Assam Tribune (assamtribune.com)

item.title: Kamrup (M) DTO resumes doorstep transport services to aid 200+vehicle owners
item.description: The Kamrup (Metro) District Transport Office will offer on-the-spot vehicle document updates, learner’s licences, tax assistance, and safety awareness

item.title: GU rejects claims of last-minute form window, cites NEP load & student interest
item.description: Gauhati University has dismissed allegations of opening its exam form window a day before exams, stating it was kept open to help students facing genuine issues.

item.title: Dibrugarh hunger strike ends, officials assure swift demolition of illegal building
item.description: Local residents said that they will continue to monitor the progress of the demolition work and will resume their agitation if the administration fails to keep its promise.

item.title: Scindia unveils Rs 646-Cr projects in Nagaland, joins Hornbill stone pulling ceremony
item.description: The Union Minister also laid foundations for key health and infrastructure works in Nagaland and praised the State’s cultural vibrancy and regional importance.

item.title: US journalist hurt in Myanmar landmine blast stable, under treatment in Aizawl
item.description: American reporter Collin Mayfield, injured in a landmine explosion while covering clashes in Myanmar’s Chin state, is recovering at Ebenezer Hospital in Aizawl

item.title: Army scales Arunachal’s highest peak Mount Kangto in first-ever recorded summit
item.description: A 18-member Indian Army team from Eastern Command has achieved the first recorded ascent of Mount Kangto (7,042 m), Arunachal Pradesh’s highest peak.

item.title: 2 Congress leaders held over SR row, released on bail in Lakhimpur
item.description: Hem Chandra Baruah & Dilwar Hussain, granted bail following arrest on BJP complaint during a voter list verification drive
